safe_interpretation: Recurring MCST oversight shows that royalty-governance friction is a live institutional variable rather than a one-off dispute.
The official conflict-of-interest finding is the strongest direct signal that domestic rights administration cannot simply be treated as a neutral referee in external platform disputes.
Improper budget execution supports treating domestic rights administration as a source of governance friction rather than a pure pass-through mechanism.
Procurement and favoritism findings indicate that internal-control weakness can add allocative and verification friction beyond royalty-formula disputes alone.
Member-democracy and election-neutrality findings support modeling governance friction as a bargaining-legitimacy problem as well as an accounting problem.
Governance-transparency risk is system-level rather than KOMCA-only because notice and recruitment opacity was also found in another trust-management body.
Multi-organization audit findings broaden the rights-governance friction layer beyond a single institution or single dispute.
The follow-up reform plan is a mitigation signal showing that governance friction is policy-addressable, although the current panel does not assume full compliance or full resolution.
A separate official claims portal shows that some YouTube-linked royalty settlement work occurs outside the ordinary public-tariff workflow.
The 24-month unclaimed definition supports a delay and matching interpretation rather than a blanket misconduct claim.
Non-member access weakens a pure insider-only story, though it does not remove information or matching frictions.
The residual log is limited to Korea and 2016Q3 to 2022Q2, so the workflow cannot be read as a full-series settlement record.
Content ID identification limits indicate metadata and matching friction in addition to any contractual-rate question.
The safest reading is a special-case verification workflow that lowers transparency and comparability without by itself proving unfair rates or unlawful withholding.
